title: BIASING
markdownDescription:
En: Weight Window biasing for faster simulation convergence.
Ru: Weight Window биасинг для ускорения сходимости моделирования.

See: WeightWindowManager.cc, PhysicsManager.cc.

Example:
```yaml
BIASING:
  weightWindow:
    ENABLE: true
    particles: ["e-", "gamma"]
    mesh:
      type: manual
      manual:
        bins: [10, 10, 10]
        min: ["-5*cm", "-5*cm", "-5*cm"]
        max: ["5*cm", "5*cm", "5*cm"]
    algorithm:
      upperLimitFactor: 5.0
      survivalFactor: 3.0
```
